info.name: Stockflow Android Shopkeeper API
info.description: Postman Collection v2.1 for Stockflow's authenticated shopkeeper API. Create a bearer token in /stockflow/api-tokens and set apiToken. Review the checkout response, copy review_hash into the reviewHash variable, then send the same order body to Confirm reviewed checkout. Replace example product identifiers and customer details with real values. Cash confirmation finalizes payment and inventory immediately; Quote and Purchase Order remain pending. Do not retry blindly after a timeout. Saved response examples are included for each endpoint status returned by the API. Confirm checkout with a unique Idempotency-Key; reuse the same key and body when retrying, and use a new key for each new checkout.

request.description: After reviewing the response from Checkout / Review, set the reviewHash collection variable to its review_hash and submit the same checkout body here. Recalculates prices, stock, taxes, and discounts; if anything changed, returns 409 and a new review instead of creating the order. Cash is marked paid immediately. Change payment_method to quote or purchase_order to leave payment pending. Do not retry blindly after a timeout. Set idempotencyKey to a fresh unique value for each order. If this request times out, retry with exactly the same key and body; the API replays its saved result for 24 hours. Example key: a newly generated UUID such as 8d5f4b51-7d3b-4e16-b9f0-56a48e968857.

item.description: All checkout variants use the server-side catalog price and stock checks. Use pickup without addresses. For delivery, provide a valid shipping_method from checkout-options plus billing_address and, optionally, shipping_address. Item tax_ids and discount_id and order_tax_ids/order_discount_id are optional.
